# rwx_directory_group (Data Source)

Looks up an existing identity-provider group in an RWX directory. Configure `directory_id` and exactly one of `name` or `id`; both selectors return their resolved values. This data source does not provision groups or manage IdP-owned rosters. Name lookups must match exactly one group in the directory. Use the stable local RWX `id` to retain identity across renames; ID lookups never fall back to a same-named replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rwx_directory" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}

data "rwx_directory_group" "engineering" {
  directory_id = data.rwx_directory.engineering.id
  name         = "Engineering"
}

data "rwx_directory_group" "by_id" {
  directory_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  id           = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_id` (String) The local RWX directory ID. The directory must belong to the authenticated organization.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The stable local RWX directory-group ID, not the external IdP ID. Configure either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) The exact, case-sensitive group name within the directory. Configure either `id` or `name`. When looking up by ID, returns the current name.
